description: Who or what is present in the scene. Subjects can include humans, creatures, robots, animals, fantasy beings, and personified objects.
use_when: When the request involves visible subjects or subject creation.

description: What subjects are doing and how they are positioned while doing it: individual activities, interactions between subjects, and the posture or body arrangement that goes with them, for solo, couple and group scenes.
use_when: When the scene involves an action, an interaction, or a specific pose or arrangement of subjects.

description: Where the scene takes place, including environments, locations, backgrounds, and surrounding spaces.
use_when: When a location or environment is relevant.

description: Every physical thing in or around the scene other than the subjects themselves: anything that can be seen, held, used, worn when it is not clothing, ridden, driven, written on or placed. Tools, devices, kitchenware, toys, games, furniture, vehicles, buildings and structures seen in the scene, food, plants, restraints and equipment, and text: printed, written, engraved or drawn words and marks on signs, objects or skin. Where the scene takes place belongs to Spaces, outfits to Clothing.
use_when: When the scene needs things: something used by a subject, used on a subject, used for the action, held, carried, worn, written on or standing in the space or background.

description: Facial expressions and visible emotional reactions belonging to subjects.
use_when: When a subject's expression or visible emotional state is relevant.

description: Outfits, garments, fashion, accessories, and clothing appearance.
use_when: When clothing or outfit styling is relevant.

description: The emotional atmosphere, attitude, feeling, or overall tone of a scene.
use_when: When the scene calls for a particular emotional atmosphere or attitude.

description: Light sources, illumination, shadows, lighting conditions, and lighting aesthetics.
use_when: When lighting contributes to the scene.

description: The visual viewpoint, framing, shot size, perspective, and composition of the image.
use_when: When framing or viewpoint is relevant.

description: Visible environmental, atmospheric, magical, or cinematic effects.
use_when: When environmental or visual effects contribute to the scene.
